theme_details.description: A sophisticated nautical-themed management dashboard tailored for boatyard professionals. Avoids AI slop and cheesy maritime tropes (no anchors, ship wheels). Focuses on high-end marina aesthetics using deep sea navy and teak wood accents.

typography.instructions: Use Satoshi for Headings to provide a structured, premium tech feel. Use Chivo for Body and Data to ensure high legibility for numbers, lengths, and pricing. AVOID Inter, Roboto, or generic sans-serif fonts for headings.

font_weights.headings: font-black or font-medium (Avoid default bold, create contrast)

colors.instructions: Map these values to the Tailwind CSS variables in index.css. Never use teal green or teal blue. Never use generic purple gradients.
colors.semantic_notes: Primary is 'Teak Wood' (burnt orange/terracotta), Background is 'Sea Salt' (warm off-white) or 'Deep Ocean' (Navy) depending on the theme. Avoid pure black and pure white.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use crisp, cardless designs or very subtle roundness (max 8px). Flat solid surfaces. Use 1px inner borders to separate elements.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for floating elements, but prefer solid borders (border-border/40) for dashboard structure.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlays can be used on dark blue headers to emulate water depth, but keep it minimal and professional.
visual_enhancers.motion: Fast, functional micro-interactions. Ensure buttons and table rows have hover states. Use framer-motion for smooth entry of data grids.

layouts.grid_system: High-Density Grid for the dashboard (Bento Style). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap Strategy: Tight (gap-4 or gap-6).
layouts.spacing: Generous padding inside containers. Never let text touch borders. p-6 or p-8 inside primary cards.
layouts.navigation: Left sidebar or top navigation with solid background. NO fully transparent headers if content scrolls underneath.
layouts.alignment: Left-align all data labels and tabular data for optimal scannability. Numbers and currency can be right-aligned in tables.

components.forms: Detailed form for customer data (name, boat type, length, parking type). Group related fields intuitively. Use Shadcn Input, Select, and Switch/Checkbox.
components.tables: Use Shadcn Table for the client list. Implement hover states on rows. Include distinct status badges for 'Inside' vs 'Outside' parking.
components.buttons: Primary actions in Teak color. Pill-shaped or subtle rounded-md. Include hover and active state transformations.
components.charts: Use Recharts (Shadcn Chart). Bar charts for estimated revenue, pie/donut charts for occupied vs free boat spaces. Use a nautical palette (Navy, Sand, Teak, Light Blue).
components.cards: Subtle borders, no excessive drop shadows. 'Tactical Minimalism' - rely on 1px strokes rather than soft shadows.
components.modals: Use for Tariff configurations and detailed notes on performed maintenance work.

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Keep icons minimal. Examples: Anchor/Ship for branding (sparingly), FileText for notes, Map for mooring spots, Euro for tariffs.

images.description: Aerial shot of numerous boats docked in a marina under sunlight. Good for login background or header banners.
Brown ship deck teak texture. Can be used as a subtle overlay or accent image in the UI.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. Example: data-testid='client-form-submit'.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast on teak buttons is at least 4.5:1. Use white text over the primary Teak color.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all inputs and buttons. ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load 'Satoshi' and 'Chivo' via Google Fonts or Fontsource in index.html/CSS.
Implement the HSL color variables provided in this file directly into the :root and .dark selectors of index.css.
Create a responsive dashboard featuring statistics: occupied/free spots, estimated revenue.
Create a client list view (table) with filtering capabilities for the 200 boat spots.

Build a detailed customer form including: name, surname, boat type, length, inside/outside parking switch, and dynamic cost calculation fields (cover, hauling, launching, antifouling, engine maintenance).
Include an interface to configure base tariffs (€/meter) with manual override.
Create a view for the grid/map of parking spots with their status.
Provide a simulated export to Excel/PDF button with loading states.
The UI must be entirely in Italian as requested.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics (e.g., simplistic purple gradients, boring layouts).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp borders.
Never apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties like color, opacity, transform.
Never center-align the app container via .App { text-align: center; }. Maintain natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant Emojis (🤖🧠💭) for icons. Use proper SVG icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, active states, entrance animations.
Use generous spacing; cramped designs look cheap.
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in headers, overlays, or dropdowns.
